snippet.title: Rhythm Animal Cafe - Official Announce Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Welcome to ​Rhythm Animal Café​! Animals' daily chaos meets funky beats: boss hype, colleague woes, your slacking, unfair blame - all become hilarious one-tap rhythm games! Here's your look at Rhythm Animal Café in this first trailer for the upcoming game. Rhythm Animal Café will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
